faq.question: What is Enquiro?
faq.answer: Enquiro is an enquiry and lead management system. It collects enquiries from your website into one admin panel, lets admins filter and export them to Excel, and lets you allocate each enquiry to an employee who adds comments and updates its status.

faq.question: Who uses Enquiro?
faq.answer: All my real estate clients use it, including Infinity Realty, LandCity Properties, Prime Properties JD, Space Realtors and Kshemrealty.

faq.question: Can employees see only their own enquiries?
faq.answer: Yes. Each employee sees only the enquiries allocated to them. Admins, and any users you give access to, can see all enquiries.

faq.question: Can I export enquiries to Excel?
faq.answer: Yes. Apply the filters you need and export that list to Excel.

faq.question: Can I see the source code?
faq.answer: The source code is private, so it is not published. During the demo I can walk you through how it is built and answer technical questions.
